# Data, not code: the underlying research gets corrected and extended, and a
# wrong row should be fixable without editing a script.
#   documented  - stated in the cited source
#   observed    - widely reported for that hardware, not formally published
#   unverified  - plausible, NOT confirmed; treat as a hypothesis only
#   unknown     - no derivation known; a generator cannot help
# charset codes: hex-lower hex-upper lower lower-digit alnum digits
# class codes:   label-random (printed on the sticker, no derivation)
